premises.text: Last-minute personal service booking by phone/listings is inefficient for customers
premises.evidence_span: It seemed really inefficient that I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Idle local service businesses want paying customers but dislike expensive, complicated, risky acquisition channels that remove timing control
premises.evidence_span: merchants didn't get the control on when the customer was coming through their door

premises.text: Customers submit named-price service bids with constraints; merchants accept when capacity allows
premises.evidence_span: you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Bidzee monetizes merchant idle time with zero upfront cost and card-backed immediacy
premises.evidence_span: They have bottom-of-the-funnel customers who have already put a credit card behind their offer, and they have certainty and immediacy of when the service is expected

premises.text: Trust comes from verified rated local businesses rather than neighbor C2C labor
premises.evidence_span: Unlike consumer to consumer marketplaces, such as TaskRabbit, that connects you with a local consumer to perform the task, BidZ is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business

value.text: Get needed local services quickly on the customer's terms while filling merchant idle slots
value.evidence_span: BidZ has allowed me to get the service that I desperately need and put extra money in the pocket of this merchant

causal_links.evidence_span: marketplaces can effectively solve these inefficiencies
prefer to get our hair cut by a professional

notes: Singleton trust domain: verified-business constraint separately revisable from bidding mechanics. Local market size claim excluded as framing.
